product.summary: A native C++20/Qt workstation for seeded procedural hip-hop sample generation, real stereo rendering and PCM16 WAV pack export with versioned manifests.
proof_points: Offline deterministic generation from fixed seeds and parameters.
Stereo PCM16 WAV exports with versioned pack metadata.
Multiple production profiles and bounded WAV chop import/resampling workflows.
non_claims: Procedural generation does not grant rights to imported or third-party source samples.
A generated pack is not automatically cleared for commercial redistribution.
Sales, audience demand, unique buyers and profitability are not established.

audiences.need: Create repeatable starting material and audition variations without an online dependency.
audiences.value: Offline generation with reproducible settings and WAV export.

audiences.need: Build, inspect and organize repeatable audio-pack drafts.
audiences.value: Structured exports with manifests and measurable audio metadata.

audiences.need: Demonstrate rhythm, variation and sample-pack construction.
audiences.value: Deterministic examples and inspectable parameter-to-render workflows.

positioning.statement: VentuSample is an offline, reproducible sample-pack workstation for producers who want controllable hip-hop material and direct WAV exports.
differentiators: Seeded procedural generation supports repeatable results.
Native C++20/Qt desktop architecture with offline stereo rendering.
Versioned manifests and PCM16 WAV exports make generated packs inspectable.

brand.promise: Give producers repeatable control over the creation and export of original sample-pack material.

stages.name: Problem discovery
stages.success_criteria: Collect producer feedback on actual generation, audition and export workflows.

stages.name: Message and documentation
stages.success_criteria: README describes generated outputs, profiles, controls and engineering boundaries.

stages.name: Distribution
stages.success_criteria: The public repository documents source/build access; sample-pack sales are not established.

stages.name: User validation
stages.success_criteria: Evaluate whether producers reuse generated material and which controls matter.

stages.name: Retention and support
stages.success_criteria: Maintain format compatibility, versioned manifests and a clear update policy.

channels.name: GitHub repository and technical documentation
channels.purpose: Explain offline generation, controls, export formats and build path.
channels.guardrail: Do not imply a public sales channel where none is documented.

channels.name: Demonstration packs and audio previews
channels.purpose: Let producers audition representative outputs and compare settings.
channels.guardrail: Publish only content with cleared source rights and documented provenance.

channels.name: Producer and sound-design communities
channels.purpose: Collect workflow feedback and evaluate repeat-use value.
channels.guardrail: No spam, fake testimonials or guaranteed commercial-success claims.

channels.name: Versioned release notes
channels.purpose: Explain generator changes, manifest versions and compatibility.
channels.guardrail: Keep WAV format and manifest compatibility statements testable.

market_validation.notes: No structured producer-demand, conversion or repeat-use evidence is asserted.

pricing.notes: No price, subscription or paid pack strategy is defined.

unit_economics.notes: Generation, curation, hosting, platform fees and support costs require measurement.

licensing.notes: Verify rights to every imported source sample and any third-party material before commercial distribution.

support.notes: Define supported operating systems, Qt/runtime dependencies and format compatibility policy.

distribution.notes: The public source repository and pack-export workflow exist; a paid distribution channel is not established.

metrics.name: First successful exported pack
metrics.definition: Share of evaluators who generate and validate a WAV pack with a manifest.
metrics.source: Consent-based evaluation or explicit user feedback.
metrics.privacy_note: No hidden audio collection or telemetry.

metrics.name: Repeat-use rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluators who return and create another pack under a new or reused configuration.
metrics.source: Voluntary feedback or a privacy-reviewed opt-in study.
metrics.privacy_note: Do not infer repeat use from downloads.

metrics.name: Pack integrity
metrics.definition: Share of exported packs passing manifest, file and audio-bound checks.
metrics.source: Existing automated tests and pack validation output.
metrics.privacy_note: Integrity does not establish copyright clearance or market demand.

governance.claims: Describe deterministic generation and output formats precisely; disclose platform/build prerequisites and distinguish pack integrity from audio quality or rights clearance.
governance.promotion: Use representative audio previews and producer-focused demonstrations only after source rights and provenance are reviewed.
governance.privacy: Keep generation offline by default; do not upload user WAV files or collect listening history without explicit opt-in.
governance.rights: Manual rights review is mandatory for imported source samples, loops, recordings and third-party assets before paid or public redistribution.
